safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state that the patient has no past history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute insect-sting encounter with reported dyspnea/lip symptoms, documenting absence of prior anaphylaxis helps risk-stratify and guide urgency/follow-up planning. Omission could lead to unnecessary escalation or confusion in subsequent care, but is unlikely by itself to cause direct harm in this single visit.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not recording that the patient has never used/been prescribed an epinephrine auto-injector removes a useful marker of prior severe allergic reactions and can affect future triage and counseling (e.g., whether to prescribe/educate on epinephrine). This is typically a documentation/continuity risk rather than an immediate treatment error here.
